Tools
======

Below are the tools required for the build of the OpenCAL printer. 
It includes machinery and handheld tools for all phases of the build.

Machinery
----------
* Laser Cutter
    * 1/4'' Acrylic Capable
    * Minimum Bed Size of __________
    * **Laser Cutter used to make original version: _____________**
* 3D Printer  
    * PLA Capable
    * Minimum Bed Size of __________
    * **3D Printer used to make original version: _____________**
* Bandsaw / Generic Saw
    * Aluminum Capable
    * Ability to Perform Semi-precision Cuts
    * **Bandsaw used to make original version: _____________**

Handheld Tools
--------------
* Metric Hex Key Set
* Adjustable Wrench
